title: The Covenant
textType: Compilation of extracts from the Bahá’í writings
attributionNote: The Covenant: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its Compilations shelf.
description: Materials assembled by the Research Department of the Universal House of Justice The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (Compilations).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.

chapters.label: I.A Covenant: “...a binding agreement between God and man...”
II.“...the Greater Covenant which every Manifestation of God makes with His followers...” — The Pattern
III.The Lesser Covenant: “...that Bahá’u’lláh made with His followers regarding ‘Abdu’l-Bahá...” — Appointment
IV.The Lesser Covenant: “...that ‘Abdu’l-Bahá perpetuated through the Administrative Order...” — Twin Successors
V.Response to the Lesser Covenant assures that “...the Faith can remain united and pure.”
